## Workload

Hannah Lowe completed 556 reads during 292 hours of grading activity. This represents an average of 1.9 reads per hour. The workload was recorded against the hours available for grading, providing a clear measure of throughput for the review period.

## Quality

A sample of 41 reads was checked as part of the quality review. The recorded agreement was 48.8. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases to support consistent grading and clarify expectations for similar work.

Priya Anand reviewed the grading activity and considered both the workload recorded and the results of the quality checks.
